The IRF board clock or fiber cables were interrupted. 
TPS Reset required before scanning.

VRF - Error bit(s) activated in Link Control Status Register (0x0030). 
The VRF is located at ICN1(ICN2), if ADS(ADS1) 
reports this error.
VRF ID: 0x0 
Link Control Status Register: 0x131000000000->

VRF - Error bit(s) activated in RRX Status Register 2 (0x00F8). 
The VRF is located at ICN1(ICN2), if ADS(ADS1) 
reports this error.
VRF ID: 0x0 
RRX Status Register 2:   0x1000000000000000->

VRF did not receive correct device ID from RRX module in 
scan room. RRX does not exist or is not connected to VRF. 
The VRF is located at ICN1(ICN2), if ADS(ADS1) 
reports this error.
VRF ID: 0 
Device ID: 2->

VRF - Error bit(s) activated in Control Status Register (0x0000). 
The VRF is located at ICN1(ICN2), if ADS(ADS1) 
reports this error.
VRF ID: 0x0 
Control Status Register: 0x150->
The Reference Clock to the IRF3 or IXG is not present.->

The RRX_1 module was not detected by IRF3.
The system can not scan without this module.->

No Clock Signal to IRF3 board.
The IRF3 board did not detect a clock signal on the J8 fiber optic clock cable.
This condition will cause a TPS_reset failure.->

Not enough RRX modules found.
The system did not find enough RRX modules for the number of channels
configured.->

AGP detected a fault on the fiber links connected to IRF3 or IXG or ERF.
The link to this device dropped out: IXG J13 RRX-1->

the RRX to the VRF. Check power to RRX module. The VRF is located at ICN1(ICN2), 
if ADS(ADS1) reports this error.

VRF Register: 0x30 
Descriptions:   0x0->
